The '''Tourism Council of Oluna Biqua''' was an organization that controlled tourism in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Oluna Biqua]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When a new luxury [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] and [[Casino/Legends|casino]], the [[Night Imperial]], was built in the city, [[Elkan Danneer]], a member of the council, invited the [[Heroes of Cularin]] to come and stay at the hotel free of charge.
